svg.title: Nursery Reef — Central nursery bell
svg.desc: Short shell-canopy paths curl back to a central bell. Two repair supports and a quiet alcove are distinct; bubble perches offer an optional observational loop. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.
svg.text: Shared access · None hostile; aid creature 6–10

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Short shell-canopy paths curl back to a central bell. Two repair supports and a quiet
alcove are distinct; bubble perches offer an optional observational loop.
7 raised landings · 2 stair flights · 3 rope climbs · 2 ladders · 20 placed props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
Encounter: Shellbell Nymph · Benevolent / Common; aid / escort / protection, never a kill-farm target.
